data.name: Rizqiyah
data.gender_notes: Rizqiyah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Rizqiyah is derived from the word Rizq, which means sustenance or provision. It is a name that symbolizes the blessings of Allah. The name Rizqiyah carries the meaning “Sustenance” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Rizqiyah usually hope their child will grow to embody sustenance and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: She who is blessed with sustenance, a reminder to appreciate the blessings of Allah.
data.etymology: Rizqiyah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Sustenance.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Rizqiyah total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_arabic.name: رزقية
in_arabic.meaning: رزق من الله، الخير الكثير، الرزق الحسن
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم مشتق من رزق، يعني الخير والفضل الذي ينزله الله على عباده، ويعني أيضا الرزق الحسن والمال الكثير، كما ورد في القرآن الكريم في سورة الفرقان آية 2: 'الذين يرونونك ويعبدون ربهم ويؤمنون بما أنزل عليك وما أنزل من قبلك وهم على صلاة لا يفوتون'، وقد ذكر اسم رزقية في بعض الأحاديث النبوية الشريفة، وتدل على معنى الرزق الروحي والمعنوي.

in_urdu.name: رزقیا
in_urdu.meaning: اللہ کی طرف سے رزق، بہت سا خیر، اچھا رزق
in_urdu.long_meaning: رزقیا نام کا مطلب ہے اللہ کی طرف سے رزق دینا، یا اللہ کی طرف سے ملنے والا رزق، یہ نام رزق کے عربی मूल سے ماخوذ ہے، جو قرآن و حدیث میں بھی استعمال ہوتا ہے، خاص طور پر سورة مریم میں جہاں کہا گیا ہے 'ورزقناهم من الطیب'، یہ نام اچھے اور خوش قسمت بچوں کے لیے منتخب کیا جاتا ہے، اور اسلامی روایات میں اس کا بڑا دینی اور ثقافتی اہمیت ہے.

in_hindi.name: रिज़किया
in_hindi.meaning: ईश्वर द्वारा प्रदत्त, बहुत सारा भला, अच्छा रिज़्क
in_hindi.long_meaning: रिज़किया नाम का अर्थ है ईश्वर द्वारा दिया गया रिज़्क, या ईश्वर की ओर से प्राप्त होने वाला गुजारा, यह नाम अरबी मूल से लिया गया है, जो इस्लामी परंपरा में बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है, और अक्सर अच्छे भाग्य और समृद्धि के प्रतीक के रूप में प्रयोग किया जाता है, इस्लामी समुदाय में माता-पिता अपने बच्चों को यह नाम देने का चयन करते हैं ताकि वे आध्यात्मिक और नैतिक मूल्यों के साथ बड़े हों.

in_pashto.name: رزقيه
in_pashto.meaning: دالله څخه رزق، ډیر خیر، ښه رزق
in_pashto.long_meaning: رزقيه نوم معنی دالله څخه رزق یا دالله طرفه ورکړل شوي روزي، دا نوم د رزق عربي اصل څخه اخیستل شوی، په قرآن او حدیث کې هم کارول شوی، په ځانګړي ډول د مریم سوره کې چیرې چې ویل شوي 'ورزقناهم من الطیب'، دا نوم د ښو او خوشحاله ماشومانو لپاره غوره کیږي، او په اسلامي روایاتو کې لوی مذهبي او کلتوري اهميت لري.

in_english.name: Rizqiyah
in_english.meaning: Provision from Allah, abundance of good, good sustenance
in_english.long_meaning: Rizqiyah is derived from the Arabic root 'rizq', meaning sustenance or provision from Allah. In Islamic tradition, it signifies the spiritual and material support provided by God. The term is mentioned in the Quran, specifically in Surah Al-Furqan, verse 2, and other related verses. Historically, the name Rizqiyah has been used to express gratitude for divine blessings and to invoke continued providence. It symbolizes a parent's hope for their child's well-being and spiritual growth.

data.cultural_impact: The name Rizqiyah is commonly given to Muslim girls, and it represents the idea that everything in life comes from Allah. In Islamic culture, this name signifies the belief that material and spiritual needs are provided by Allah. It encourages a sense of gratitude and reliance on Allah for daily needs and material possessions.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Rizqiyah holds spiritual significance for Muslims, as it serves as a reminder of the divine origin of all things. It encourages a deeper connection with Allah, as one recognizes that all sustenance comes from Him. It also promotes a sense of contentment and satisfaction in life, as one recognizes that Allah is the giver of all blessings. Ultimately, the name Rizqiyah inspire the bearer to lead a life in submission to Allah, with a deep sense of gratitude and reliance on Him.

In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Rizqiyah serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of sustenance.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: Rizqiyah bint 'Amr ibn 'Al-'As was a poetess and a singer in the court of the Umayyad caliph Hisham ibn Abd al-Malik.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Rizqiyah remains relevant in modern Muslim society, representing a bridge between traditional Islamic values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Islamic names.
